Name: (AT) More Buildings for Cute Valley Blue for Alternative Textures
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
Like many others before me, I'm sure, when I found the [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]Cute Valley mod[/url], made by [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie [/url]on the Chucklefish forums ([i]now also posted [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3499]here on Nexus[/url][/i]), I loved it instantly. The house and stable included in the mod are adorable! I was a little sad, however, at how lackluster the rest of my farm ended up looking in comparison. I mean, how is a girl to tend to her crops when she's distracted by the lack of cuteness in her barns and coops? So, I set out to make matching textures for all the other farm buildings! The original mod I made was for content patcher and can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15747]here[/url], but since the fantastic [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] exists now, I decided to make a content pack for it!

[b]Included in this mod are the following buildings, done in the blue style of Rosalie's Cute Valley mod;[/b]
[i]Barn
Big Barn
Deluxe Barn
Coop
Big Coop
Deluxe Coop
Fish Pond
Mill
Shed
Big Shed
Silo
Slime Hutch
Well[/i]
[i]

[/i][b]Please note that the original Cute Valley - Blue house & stable is not included in this mod. To get the house/stable, download the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3503]here[/url] or [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley.110882/]here[/url]![/b]


This content pack mod is for the awesome[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url], by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url], so both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] are required for it to work.

If you prefer pink to blue, you can find my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15843][AT] More Buildings for Cute Valley Pink[/url] mod over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15843]here[/url]﻿!

If you're looking for the content patcher version of this mod, you can find it over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15747]here[/url]!



[b]Installation: [/b]
[b]1. [/b]Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
[b]2. [/b]Unzip the '[AT] More Buildings for Cute Valley' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
[b]3. [/b]Buy the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]Paint Bucket[/url] tool from Robin, to use on your buildings and retexture them.
[b]4. [/b]Congrats, you're done and ready to retexture! Enjoy your new farm!



[b]Credits:[/b]
[list]
[*]Massive credit, of course, to [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie [/url]﻿on the Chucklefish forums, as they created the original [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]Cute Valley mod[/url]﻿ and provided so much inspiration for these textures! Also, a few textures were reused from their houses texture, such as the flower baskets.
[/list]
